correctness.rationale: The fixed point solves a quadratic with exactly one positive root. Exact Jacobian algebra gives characteristic polynomial lambda^3-alpha lambda^2+omega lambda-alpha with -1/2<alpha<1/2 and 0<omega<1; the four strict cubic Jury conditions follow. Subtracting the two period-two identities gives (A-B)[v+2a+r(A+B)]=0. Simple-root perturbation at 0, plus/minus i proves the sharp square-root spectral gap. The exact identities and finite diagnostics passed in check.py.

value.rationale: The asymptotic square-root closing of a stability gap, with leading constant controlled only by baseline numerator/denominator parameters and not the same-parity couplings, explains naturally motivated metastable near-four-step dynamics under strong delayed inhibition while finite-parameter stability persists. The statement applies to an open five-parameter class and excludes actual two-cycles; it is not a single numerical spectral test or arbitrary parameter slice.
